Source: You can now awaken your affinity!
en: You can now awaken your affinity!

Source: Defeat Thornlings in the Emerald Verge ({progress}/{count})
es: Derrota Brotespinas en la Linde Esmeralda ({progress}/{count})
en: Defeat Thornlings in the Emerald Verge ({progress}/{count})

Source: Welcome to Dawn Camp, seeker. Before you enter the forest, show me you can use your katana: strike the training dummy. Left click to attack; right click for a heavy strike.
es: Bienvenido al Campamento del Alba, explorador. Antes de entrar al bosque, demuéstrame que sabes usar tu katana: golpea al muñeco de práctica. Clic izquierdo para atacar; clic derecho para un golpe pesado.
en: Welcome to Dawn Camp, seeker. Before you enter the forest, show me you can use your katana: strike the training dummy. Left click to attack; right click for a heavy strike.

Source: Hit the dummy a few more times. Try the combo: two left clicks and one right click.
es: Golpea al muñeco unas cuantas veces más. Prueba el combo: dos clics izquierdos y uno derecho.
en: Hit the dummy a few more times. Try the combo: two left clicks and one right click.

Source: Well done! Remember: Q to dodge and F to block. Block right before a hit to stun your enemy.
es: ¡Bien hecho! Recuerda: Q para esquivar y F para bloquear. Si bloqueas justo antes del golpe, aturdirás al enemigo.
en: Well done! Remember: Q to dodge and F to block. Block right before a hit to stun your enemy.

Source: Corrupted Aether has awakened the forest roots. Follow the path north to the Emerald Verge and defeat the Thornlings. When they glow, get ready to block or dodge!
es: El Éter corrompido ha despertado a las raíces del bosque. Sigue el camino hacia el norte hasta la Linde Esmeralda y derrota a los Brotespinas. Cuando brillen, ¡prepárate para bloquear o esquivar!
en: Corrupted Aether has awakened the forest roots. Follow the path north to the Emerald Verge and defeat the Thornlings. When they glow, get ready to block or dodge!

Source: The Thornlings are still restless in the Emerald Verge, to the north. Don't come back until you've calmed a few.
es: Los Brotespinas siguen inquietos en la Linde Esmeralda, al norte. No vuelvas hasta calmar a unos cuantos.
en: The Thornlings are still restless in the Emerald Verge, to the north. Don't come back until you've calmed a few.

Source: You have shown courage. But the forest holds many secrets… Talk to me again whenever you are ready.
es: Has demostrado valor. Pero el bosque guarda muchos secretos… Habla conmigo de nuevo cuando quieras.
en: You have shown courage. But the forest holds many secrets… Talk to me again whenever you are ready.

Source: Rest, seeker. There will be more to do soon.
es: Descansa, explorador. Pronto habrá más por hacer.
en: Rest, seeker. There will be more to do soon.

Source: Explore the ruins west of the Emerald Verge
es: Explora las ruinas al oeste de la Linde Esmeralda
en: Explore the ruins west of the Emerald Verge

Source: Awaken your affinity at the Shrine
es: Despierta tu afinidad en el Santuario
en: Awaken your affinity at the Shrine

es: Consigue Savia corrupta de los enemigos ({progress}/{count})

Source: Defeat Vharok in the Forest Heart
es: Derrota a Vharok en el Corazón del Bosque
en: Defeat Vharok in the Forest Heart

Source: West of the Verge lie some Aelith ruins. They say a Fragment of Dawn fell there after the Great Eclipse. Go take a look.
es: Al oeste de la Linde hay unas ruinas de los Aelith. Dicen que allí cayó un Fragmento de Amanecer tras el Gran Eclipse. Ve a echar un vistazo.
en: West of the Verge lie some Aelith ruins. They say a Fragment of Dawn fell there after the Great Eclipse. Go take a look.

Source: The ruins are west of the Emerald Verge clearing. Look for the stone pillars.
es: Las ruinas están al oeste del claro de la Linde Esmeralda. Busca los pilares de piedra.
en: The ruins are west of the Emerald Verge clearing. Look for the stone pillars.

Source: Did you feel that warmth? That's the light of the first dawn. The Aelith used it to calm the Aether… Perhaps there's still hope for the forest.
es: ¿Sentiste esa calidez? Es la luz del primer amanecer. Los Aelith la usaban para calmar el Éter… Quizás aún haya esperanza para el bosque.
en: Did you feel that warmth? That's the light of the first dawn. The Aelith used it to calm the Aether… Perhaps there's still hope for the forest.

Source: Thornling Spitters attack from afar and have wounded several seekers. Defeat a few and I'll give you something heavier than that katana.
es: Los Brotespinas Lanzadores atacan desde lejos y han herido a varios exploradores. Derrota a unos cuantos y te daré algo con más peso que esa katana.
en: Thornling Spitters attack from afar and have wounded several seekers. Defeat a few and I'll give you something heavier than that katana.

Source: The Spitters hide northeast of the Verge. Dodge their spines or block them.
es: Los Lanzadores se esconden al noreste de la Linde. Esquiva sus espinas o bloquéalas.
en: The Spitters hide northeast of the Verge. Dodge their spines or block them.

Source: Take this greatsword. It's slow, but it hits several enemies at once. You can switch weapons in your inventory (Tab or I).
es: Toma este mandoble. Es lento, pero golpea a varios enemigos a la vez. Puedes cambiar de arma en tu inventario (Tab o I).
en: Take this greatsword. It's slow, but it hits several enemies at once. You can switch weapons in your inventory (Tab or I).

Source: You've grown a lot, seeker. It's time to awaken the Aether within you. Go to the Shrine and choose your path: fire or lightning.
es: Has crecido mucho, explorador. Es hora de despertar el Éter que llevas dentro. Ve al Santuario y elige tu camino: el fuego o el rayo.
en: You've grown a lot, seeker. It's time to awaken the Aether within you. Go to the Shrine and choose your path: fire or lightning.

Source: The Shrine awaits. Press E next to it to awaken your affinity.
es: El Santuario te espera. Pulsa E junto a él para despertar tu afinidad.
en: The Shrine awaits. Press E next to it to awaken your affinity.

Source: I can feel your affinity. The more you use it, the stronger it becomes. And remember: you can change it at the Shrine anytime.
es: Puedo sentir tu afinidad. Cuanto más la uses, más poderosa será. Y recuerda: puedes cambiarla en el Santuario cuando quieras.
en: I can feel your affinity. The more you use it, the stronger it becomes. And remember: you can change it at the Shrine anytime.

Source: You're not ready to awaken the Aether yet. Come back when you're stronger (level 5).
es: Todavía no estás preparado para despertar el Éter. Vuelve cuando seas más fuerte (nivel 5).
en: You're not ready to awaken the Aether yet. Come back when you're stronger (level 5).

Source: The Aelith Sentries guarded the ruins, but corrupted Aether has turned them against us. Their shield blocks light attacks: use heavy attacks and beware of their red strike.
es: Los Centinelas Aelith protegían las ruinas, pero el Éter corrupto los ha vuelto contra nosotros. Su escudo bloquea los golpes ligeros: usa ataques pesados y cuidado con su golpe rojo.
en: The Aelith Sentries guarded the ruins, but corrupted Aether has turned them against us. Their shield blocks light attacks: use heavy attacks and beware of their red strike.

Source: Break their guard with a heavy strike or hit them from behind. And if they glow red… dodge!
es: Rompe su guardia con un golpe pesado o atácalos por la espalda. Y si brillan en rojo… ¡esquiva!
en: Break their guard with a heavy strike or hit them from behind. And if they glow red… dodge!

Source: Impressive. Take this rare weapon, forged by the Aelith themselves.
es: Impresionante. Toma esta arma rara, la forjaron los propios Aelith.
en: Impressive. Take this rare weapon, forged by the Aelith themselves.

Source: The Sentries are dangerous. Come back when you're stronger (level 6).
es: Los Centinelas son peligrosos. Vuelve cuando seas más fuerte (nivel 6).
en: The Sentries are dangerous. Come back when you're stronger (level 6).

Source: The forest's sap is rotting because of the Aether. Bring me samples of Withered Sap from the enemies so I can study it.
es: La savia del bosque se está pudriendo por culpa del Éter. Tráeme muestras de Savia corrupta de los enemigos para estudiarla.
en: The forest's sap is rotting because of the Aether. Bring me samples of Withered Sap from the enemies so I can study it.

Source: Not every enemy carries withered sap. Keep looking.
es: No todos los enemigos llevan savia corrupta. Sigue buscando.
en: Not every enemy carries withered sap. Keep looking.

Source: This sap… comes from the Forest Heart. Something terrible has awakened there.
es: Esta savia… viene del Corazón del Bosque. Algo terrible ha despertado allí.
en: This sap… comes from the Forest Heart. Something terrible has awakened there.

Source: It's not safe to go that deep into the forest yet. Come back when you're stronger (level 10).
es: Todavía no es seguro adentrarse tanto en el bosque. Vuelve cuando seas más fuerte (nivel 10).
en: It's not safe to go that deep into the forest yet. Come back when you're stronger (level 10).

Source: Vharok, the forest's Warden, has been corrupted. If we defeat him, the Primeval Tree can heal. Gather other seekers: don't go alone.
es: Vharok, el Guardián del bosque, ha sido corrompido. Si lo derrotamos, el Árbol Primigenio podrá sanar. Reúne a otros exploradores: no vayas solo.
en: Vharok, the forest's Warden, has been corrupted. If we defeat him, the Primeval Tree can heal. Gather other seekers: don't go alone.

Source: Vharok awaits in the Forest Heart. Prepare well before you go.
es: Vharok espera en el Corazón del Bosque. Prepárate bien antes de ir.
en: Vharok awaits in the Forest Heart. Prepare well before you go.

Source: You did it! The Primeval Tree shines again… and it has revealed a sealed portal. That symbol… belongs to another region. Your journey has only just begun.
es: ¡Lo lograste! El Árbol Primigenio vuelve a brillar… y ha revelado un portal sellado. Ese símbolo… pertenece a otra región. Tu viaje acaba de empezar.
en: You did it! The Primeval Tree shines again… and it has revealed a sealed portal. That symbol… belongs to another region. Your journey has only just begun.

Source: Vharok is too powerful for you right now. Come back when you're stronger (level 14).
es: Vharok es demasiado poderoso para ti ahora. Vuelve cuando seas más fuerte (nivel 14).
en: Vharok is too powerful for you right now. Come back when you're stronger (level 14).

es: Cura el 40 % de tu vida. Tecla 1.

Source: Level up to earn titles and auras (levels 10, 15 and 20).
es: Sube de nivel para conseguir títulos y auras (niveles 10, 15 y 20).
en: Level up to earn titles and auras (levels 10, 15 and 20).

Source: You need level {level} to awaken your affinity
es: Necesitas nivel {level} para despertar tu afinidad
en: You need level {level} to awaken your affinity

Source: You can change it for free at this Shrine. Your mastery is saved separately.
es: Podrás cambiarla gratis en este Santuario. Tu maestría se guarda por separado.
en: You can change it for free at this Shrine. Your mastery is saved separately.

Source: Blazing Arc: a fiery arc that burns enemies. Ultimate: Dawnburst.
es: Tajo Ígneo: arco de fuego que quema a los enemigos. Ulti: Erupción del Alba.
en: Blazing Arc: a fiery arc that burns enemies. Ultimate: Dawnburst.

Source: Thunder Step: an electric dash. Ultimate: Thunder Verdict.
es: Paso Relámpago: embestida eléctrica. Ulti: Juicio del Trueno.
en: Thunder Step: an electric dash. Ultimate: Thunder Verdict.

Source: You can't travel in the middle of combat
es: No puedes viajar en pleno combate
en: You can't travel in the middle of combat

Source: Awaken your affinity first at the Shrine in the Aelith Ruins
es: Despierta tu afinidad primero en el Santuario de las Ruinas de Aelith
en: Awaken your affinity first at the Shrine in the Aelith Ruins

Source: "The day the sun went out, the Aether roared like a beast. And when the light returned, it fell from the sky like crystal rain."
es: «El día que el sol se apagó, el Éter rugió como una bestia. Y cuando volvió la luz, cayó del cielo como lluvia de cristal.»
en: "The day the sun went out, the Aether roared like a beast. And when the light returned, it fell from the sky like crystal rain."

Source: The Aelith called the Aether "the breath of the world." With it they grew forests in a single night.
es: Los Aelith llamaban al Éter «el aliento del mundo». Con él hacían crecer bosques en una sola noche.
en: The Aelith called the Aether "the breath of the world." With it they grew forests in a single night.

Source: Inscription: "We keep the light of the first dawn. Whoever holds it may calm what the Eclipse awakened."
es: Inscripción: «Guardamos la luz del primer amanecer. Quien la sostenga podrá calmar lo que el Eclipse despertó.»
en: Inscription: "We keep the light of the first dawn. Whoever holds it may calm what the Eclipse awakened."

Source: The Sentries were made to protect the Shrine. They obeyed whoever bore the Aelith seal.
es: Los Centinelas fueron creados para proteger el Santuario. Obedecían a quien portara el sello de los Aelith.
en: The Sentries were made to protect the Shrine. They obeyed whoever bore the Aelith seal.

Source: At the Shrine, each seeker chose a path: the fire that purifies or the lightning that guides.
es: En el Santuario, cada explorador elegía su camino: el fuego que purifica o el rayo que guía.
en: At the Shrine, each seeker chose a path: the fire that purifies or the lightning that guides.

Source: Aelith diary: "The Primeval Tree drinks too much Aether. Its roots darken. Vharok no longer knows us."
es: Diario de un Aelith: «El Árbol Primigenio bebe demasiado Éter. Sus raíces se oscurecen. Vharok ya no nos reconoce.»
en: Aelith diary: "The Primeval Tree drinks too much Aether. Its roots darken. Vharok no longer knows us."

Source: The Hollow was once a garden. Now its roots glow with raw Aether and nothing blooms.
es: La Hondonada fue un jardín. Ahora sus raíces brillan con Éter crudo y nada florece.
en: The Hollow was once a garden. Now its roots glow with raw Aether and nothing blooms.

Source: Thornlings were born from seeds touched by corrupted Aether. They are not evil: they suffer.
es: Los Brotespinas nacieron de semillas tocadas por el Éter corrupto. No son malvados: sufren.
en: Thornlings were born from seeds touched by corrupted Aether. They are not evil: they suffer.

Source: "If the Warden falls, the Tree will heal. But the seal it guards must not be opened… yet."
es: «Si el Guardián cae, el Árbol sanará. Pero el sello que protege no debe abrirse… aún.»
en: "If the Warden falls, the Tree will heal. But the seal it guards must not be opened… yet."

Source: A vision: a stone portal beneath the Tree, bearing the symbol of a land of scorching sun.
es: Una visión: un portal de piedra bajo el Árbol, y en él, el símbolo de una tierra de sol abrasador.
en: A vision: a stone portal beneath the Tree, bearing the symbol of a land of scorching sun.

es: Números de daño de otros jugadores
Sensibilidad de la cámara: menú de Roblox (Esc) → Configuración.
Algunos textos cambian al volver a entrar.

Source: You don't lose experience or items.
en: You don't lose experience or items.
